object.description: Setup: build with a valid map key, device with internet access and location permission. Steps: 1. Open a workout with a route spread over 1 km or more in Summary and Workout Detail, and view the same route on the Active map view. 2. Open a workout with exactly 1 location fix. 3. Open a workout with no location fix. Expected: On each screen all location fixes lie inside the visible map area without panning. The 1-fix and the no-fix workouts open without a crash.
